C1-X.O_nothing_new_paid_clause_fact: the frozen clause reads 'the price is the O declaration paid at genesis, and nothing new is paid at Challenge 2', and its falsifier names 'under O a price beyond the names'.  The rung paid one new declaration, the occurrence identity of price.new_at_challenge_2, without which the caller's retention is refused under both readings, so the clause is false as written and the falsifier fired.  The names clause is scored separately and hits
C1-X.evidence: U: the retained regime is fixed by the reflection up to mark renaming, a permitted automorphism exchanges the two marks, and no invariant mark form separates them; O: the marks are separated, one on near and one on far, by two invariant mark forms, but a new declaration was paid at this rung
C1-X.label: NOT FORCED

C2-1.evidence: the caller history is a supply and an occurrence admission for each whole, certified and replayed from genesis, and its regime holds two marks on opposite sides; the two supplies are the same event value
C2-1.label: NOT FORCED
C2-1.result_basis: DEFINITION-level: the reading of the caller's 'retains' is the run's decision, and the two marks on opposite sides follow from the declared convention and the declared identity policy; a hit is by construction and is not counted as content

C2-2.evidence: all four shared-policy histories are refused, each by the moving-admission refusal naming the side the mark is admitted on
C2-2.label: FORCED
C2-2.result_basis: DEFINITION-level: the refusal is the Challenge 1 moving-admission declaration replayed on a declared history, under both readings and both conventions; a hit is by construction and is not counted as content, although the declaration was made before this question arose

C2-3.evidence: the declared space has two policies, exactly one of which lets the caller retain both wholes; the price is one new admission event and the withdrawal of the token-uniqueness rule, paid by the run and equal under both readings
C2-3.label: NOT FORCED
C2-3.result_basis: DEFINITION-level: the space, its exhaustiveness, the declared policy, and the price are declarations of this rung, and the clause that only one policy admits both rests on the C2-2 refusal; a hit is by construction and is not counted as content

C2-4.evidence: exactly two new holding judgments, one per mark and per side; no name judgment, datum, or reading changes; 0 to 2 under U and 2 to 4 under O; each mark's profile is its own side; both judgments survive the growth probe
C2-4.label: FORCED
C2-4.result_basis: content: the two new judgments and their evaluation rest on retained_onSide_true_iff with retained_onSide_zero, retained_onSide_one, and retained_onSide_beyond, none of them by unfolding, and retention on retained_judgments_survive

C2-5.evidence: two permitted automorphisms under U and one under O; the reflection with the mark exchange carries mark 0 to mark 1; neither mark form is invariant under U, so none separates them
C2-5.label: FORCED
C2-5.result_basis: content: the automorphism counts and the exchanging witness are computed over the unpruned permitted-image enumeration, and the invariance of each mark form is a census over the bounded regime domain; the concrete transport is the Lean retained_exchange_transports

C2-6.evidence: under O the only permitted automorphism is the identity, both mark forms are invariant and both separate the marks, one lying on near and one on far; the other convention's regime lies in the same class under both readings
C2-6.label: FORCED
C2-6.result_basis: content: the single O automorphism and the absence of an exchanging one are computed over the unpruned search, the invariance of both mark forms is a census, and the convention class count is an isomorphism-witness computation; the raw separation is the Lean retained_marks_separated_by_a_side

C2-7.evidence: the property survives every permitted renaming in the census and holds of the retained regime; under U no invariant mark form separates the two wholes, under O both do
C2-7.label: FORCED
C2-7.result_basis: content: the invariance of the different-sides property is a census over every regime of at most three marks under both readings and every permitted image of each

C2-8.evidence: under U a permitted automorphism exchanges the two sides and under O none does; the profile comparison is false at the retained regime under both readings; the other admission order and a different visible mark both give isomorphic regimes
C2-8.label: NOT FORCED
C2-8.result_basis: content: the side-exchanging automorphism, the order isomorphism, and the label isomorphism are witness searches over the unpruned enumeration, and none is fixed by a declaration

tally.criterion: a prediction counts as content only if at least one of its hitting clauses, read literally, rests on a theorem outside the DEFINITION-level lists of the paper's section 7 or on a computation not fixed by a declaration alone; a prediction whose every clause is true by unfolding a declaration, or reports a modelling decision of the run, is HIT by construction and not counted as content
